item.tib: mdo chog yid bzhin nor bu'i khyung sgrub kyi thugs dam rgyud bskang
item.coloph: mdo chog khyung sgrub kyi thugs dam brgyud bskang (skong) 'di ni khyung po mtshams pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ rnam dag don ldan/ g.yung drung rnam dag sogs kyis bskul ngor gsang sngags gling pas bris pa dge'o//
